name: Protagonist's Mother
source:
The protagonist's mother.  Well meaning, but interfering.  She wants the protagonist to settle down, get married and have children.

Doesn't believe that secret organisations are wanting to take over the world - nor that the protagonist is part of an organisation trying to stop that from happening.  As such, she still firmly believes that the protagonist is still at his old firm, but is too ashamed to admit it.

Well known on the professional "Funopoly" gaming circuit along with her husband.
